verdict.rationale: Airbyte supports leaving in several ways. It is open source and self-hostable via Airbyte Core, abctl and Kubernetes. Its Terraform provider and API let you keep configuration as code outside the vendor, and synced data lands in your own warehouses, lakes and databases. However, no evidence documents a dedicated export of all account data in open formats, and a community comment notes some parts are non-free. missing for 10: explicit documented full-account/config export in open formats, a migration-off guide for Cloud workspaces, independent hands-on corroboration of a clean exit.
